verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an LLM inference engine (library, CLI, and server). User-defined event-triggered automation rules are a workflow-automation capability outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence suggests it ships such a feature. Its server, web UI, and GBNF grammars cover inference and output constraints, not event-driven rules or actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
